label: ACEScct / AP1 (creative working space)

signal.notes: ACEScct floating point values (0.0729 = scene black, 0.4136 = 18% grey). No data-level remapping.

application: Creative Only (ACES-style Look Modification Transform). Place after a CST/IDT to ACEScct and before the output transform (ACEScct -> Rec.709). No technical conversion is baked in.
